items.title: Ford Motor (F) Lands $464.5 Million Oakville Backing As Legal Setback Mounts
items.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) secured a C$464.5 million commitment from Canada to support the expansion of its Oakville Assembly Complex. The federal and provincial funding is tied to Ford's multibillion dollar retooling of the Oakville plant for future electric vehicle production. In a separate legal development, an appellate court upheld a US$13.2 million verdict against Ford in InterMotive's trade secret misappropriation case. items.title: Ford reopens Canada auto plant, defying Trump tariffs
items.summary: Ford on Friday reopened a Canadian auto plant following a $3.5 billion retooling project, defying President Donald Trump's efforts to force auto companies to make vehicles stateside.The plant in Oakville, Ontario, west of Toronto, was upgraded during a two-year production shutdown to make "Super Duty" pickup trucks, a massive boost for a Canadian auto sector starting to buckle under the weight of Trump's tariffs.
